types.description: Defines which types of capture log items to receive. This filter can help to reduce the amount of data serialized. When no types are specified, all types are being sent.

type.description: The entry type. Equivalent to the Type column in the Capture Log.

severity.description:
Normal: normal execution. 
Message: Shown in yellow in the capture log. 
Error: Shown in red in the capture log.

objectName.description: The name of the object for the entry.

time.description: The time at which the event occurred. This is the elapsed time in milliseconds since the initialization of the sound engine.

gameObjectId.description: The game object ID for the entry.

gameObjectName.description: The game object name for the entry.

playingId.description: The playing ID for the entry.

description.description: The description for the entry. Equivalent to the Description column in the Capture Log.

objectId.description: The ID (GUID) of the object for the entry.

objectShortId.description: The short ID (32-bit) of the object for the entry.

errorCodeName.description: The error code name for the entry.
